visual.general_description: Line graph of ventilator settings against ICU days with FiO2, PEEP and delta P curves and six labelled P/F ratio points, under iASV mode arrows.
visual.detailed_description: At the top, a gray arrow reads iASV (%minute volume = tidal volume x frequency) followed by a red arrow reading iASV (%MV, PEEP, FiO2). The plot has a left y-axis labelled "%, cmH2O" with ticks 0 to 70 in steps of 10, and a right y-axis labelled "cmH2O" with ticks 0 to 1.6 in steps of 0.2. The x-axis has ticks 0 to 5 labelled "ICU days" with the text "Ventilator associated event" printed below the x-axis; thin blue vertical lines are drawn in the plot area and a dashed black vertical line is present. A blue line labelled FiO2, a red line labelled PEEP and a green jagged line labelled delta P (printed as a delta symbol with P) run across the plot. Six black points carry printed labels 462, 280, 171.5, 156.8, 300 and 485.7, with "P/F ratio" printed beside the first. Qualitatively, the blue FiO2 line is flat early, rises abruptly to a peak, then falls gradually with small fluctuations and one brief late spike. The red PEEP line rises in steps, stays on an elevated plateau and then steps down late. The green delta P line stays comparatively low and fluctuating throughout. No numeric values are read from the curves.
